description: Extends the shared preset at yschimke/renovate-config, which owns the release-train grouping (kotlin, androidx, and this repository's own `watchface-tools` train for the ee.schimke.watchface coordinates other repositories consume). Automerge follows the preset (minor/patch/digest/pin; majors stay manual), and `platformAutomerge` hands the merge to GitHub's native auto-merge, which waits for the checks the `Protect Main` ruleset requires (yschimke/renovate-config `repo-policy/`).
